comments.text:
I'd never heard of Tajikistan until now.  I guess I need more geography lessons.  I'm in awe of it's beautiful lakes & mountains.  But the social restrictions are mind-boggling. I can't imagine living like that especially the women. We are truly blessed in the USA.
From Grover, North Carolina USA

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: I had a similar reaction—the lakes and mountains are breathtaking, while some of the social pressures described are difficult to imagine from a U.S. perspective. 🇹🇯🏔 If you ever had the chance to visit Tajikistan, would you be more interested in the Pamir Mountains or places like Iskanderkul Lake?
